scope: Follow-up review of simplified admin/seller rental orders, cancellation/refund, tenant navigation and mobile usability.

findings.finding: Header refresh and returning from booking detail could reset search, status, date and page.
findings.resolution: Keep the loaded workspace mounted during refresh and retain list filters in same-shop component memory; clear them on shop changes.

findings.finding: External payment/status updates could leave an unavailable or outdated action selected.
findings.resolution: Reconcile the selected action against the latest booking/permissions, preserve valid manual choices, and reset successful operation fields from the returned booking.

findings.finding: Seller rental-order links preserved storeId, but tenant headers and the seller selector could use the previous selected store.
findings.resolution: Honor valid explicit request/page store IDs, keep membership-based selection, handle same-path store navigation, and clear selected rental bookings/offers on store switch. Backend tenant authorization remains enforced.

findings.finding: Staff rental notifications still opened the older Studio detail and rental alerts could be hidden by order/payment category filters.
findings.resolution: Staff booking alerts open scoped Orders → Rental; rental booking/payment/refund alerts use the matching categories. Workshop/customer routes remain appropriate.

findings.finding: Required financial/contact/inspection fields could be missing until a failed server operation.
findings.resolution: Require actual collection/refund references, valid amounts, original refund receipt, refund reason, named-contact acknowledgement, request choice and piece choice as appropriate. Display payment plan and approved deductions in the summary.

findings.finding: Invalid selected-booking responses could leave an empty detail view without an explicit recovery action.
findings.resolution: Validate the selected booking response, present Retry/All bookings, and pause mutation until a fresh successful read.

findings.finding: The store-fault full-refund option could coexist with manual retained rent.
findings.resolution: Disable retention while the full-refund option is selected, submit zero retention, and reject contradictory store-fault/positive-retention input server-side before changing the booking or reservations.

flows: Filter retention across refresh and booking/back

optionalImprovements: Compact daily pickup/return/balance summary above the rental order list, linked to existing filters.
Batch invoice printing and printable daily pickup/return lists, retaining per-booking permissions and original invoice snapshots.
outstanding: Deploy frontend and canonical backend changes.
Exercise actual OTP delivery, managed installation, transaction-capable hosted database, payment/webhook/refund providers and real physical stock on the intended deployment.
Confirm actual rental rates, merchant policies and operational responsibility with the shop.
backendChange: One cancellation input guard in backend/services/rentalService.js; no licence, ownership, payment or inventory guard bypass.
